weekly_lens.sentence: This week reflects a recovery-oriented nutritional tone where stability and energy restoration are more relevant than optimisation.

physiological_priorities.label: Energy restoration
physiological_priorities.explanation: Early menstrual phase often coincides with rebuilding energy reserves after prior cycle demand, which can show up as a need for steadiness rather than variability.

physiological_priorities.label: Stress buffering
physiological_priorities.explanation: With performance-focused training continuing, the body may prioritise predictable fuel signals to keep stress load manageable.

physiological_priorities.label: Hormonal signalling support
physiological_priorities.explanation: Regular nutritional patterns tend to align with hormonal recovery processes during this phase.

nutrition_guardrails.label: Drifting into low energy availability
nutrition_guardrails.why: Under-fuelling can quietly increase fatigue and reduce training tolerance, even when stress feels light.

nutrition_guardrails.label: High day-to-day variability
nutrition_guardrails.why: Large swings in intake patterns often show up as unstable energy or focus during recovery phases.

nutrition_guardrails.label: Over-simplification driven by convenience
nutrition_guardrails.why: Meals that lack completeness may correlate with later cravings or flat energy.

signal_to_monitor.why_it_matters: This signal often reflects whether daytime intake matched physiological demand earlier in the day.
